entities.name: Shark Island Concentration Camp
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Herero revolt January 1904 under Samuel Maharero; Battle of Waterberg August 1904; General Lothar von Trotha's extermination order (Vernichtungsbefehl); Herero driven into Omaheke Desert; Nama uprising under Hendrik Witbooi; concentration camps (Shark Island); ~65,000 Herero (80%) and ~10,000 Nama (50%) killed. Recognised as the first genocide of the 20th century.
